en: Black‑and‑white aerial view of a small town in a broad valley with patchwork fields, scattered farmhouses, and low hills or mountains in the background. The settlement has mainly wooden and low masonry buildings, a railway line with train cars along the edge, and a larger institutional-looking building in the foreground. Printed white caption text appears near the bottom right of the image.
